questions.def: Nominal relative clauses use 'what' to refer to a thing or idea.
questions.question: ___ he said surprised everyone in the room.

questions.def: 'What' introduces a nominal relative clause functioning as the subject.
questions.question: ___ is needed is a complete overhaul of the system.

questions.def: 'What' should be used, not 'that', to introduce the nominal relative clause.
questions.question: That she decided was entirely her own decision.

questions.def: 'What' introduces the nominal relative clause as subject.
questions.question: ___ he ___ is his own affair.

questions.def: 'What' introduces a clause functioning as subject.
questions.question: ___ I find interesting is the interplay of factors.

questions.def: 'What' introduces a nominal clause acting as object of the preposition 'on'.
questions.question: They disagreed on ___ constituted fair compensation.

questions.def: 'What' is correct; 'which' implies prior selection.
questions.question: Which he said remains a mystery.

questions.def: 'What' introduces nominal relative clause as the subject.
questions.question: ___ the report ___ is significant.

questions.def: 'What' is correct because it refers to something undefined.
questions.question: He dedicated his life to ___ he considered important.

questions.def: 'What' introduces a nominal clause as subject.
questions.question: ___ the committee proposes will be carefully considered.

questions.def: 'What' introduces nominal relative clause as subject.
questions.question: ___ the research ___ is crucial.

questions.def: 'What' introduces a nominal relative clause.
questions.question: ___ she said was not recorded.

questions.def: 'What' refers to the undefined thing that constitutes conflict.
questions.question: They debated ___ constituted a conflict of interest.

questions.def: 'What' introduces a nominal relative clause, not 'which'.
questions.question: Which I told him was entirely true.

questions.def: 'What' introduces a nominal clause as subject.
questions.question: ___ is ___ is more funding.

questions.def: 'What' introduces the nominal relative clause.
questions.question: ___ is important is that we act quickly.

questions.def: 'What' describes the undefined content of the research.
questions.question: I focused on ___ the research revealed.

questions.def: 'What' is used to introduce a nominal relative clause.
questions.question: That he believes is irrelevant now.

questions.def: 'What happens' is the nominal relative clause subject.
questions.question: ___ ___ next is crucial.

questions.def: 'What' introduces a nominal relative clause.
questions.question: ___ she discovered was quite shocking.

questions.def: 'What' introduces the object of the preposition 'on'.
questions.question: He elaborated on ___ he perceived as the core issue.

questions.def: 'What' is correct; 'which' implies a specific prior selection.
questions.question: Which they proposed was rejected outright.

questions.def: 'What' introduces the nominal clause as subject.
questions.question: ___ ___ in the meeting is confidential.

questions.def: 'What' introduces the nominal relative clause.
questions.question: I'm interested in ___ he intends to do.

questions.def: 'What' introduces a nominal clause which serves as subject.
questions.question: ___ he said contradicted his earlier statements.

questions.def: 'What' introduces a nominal relative clause, not 'that'.
questions.question: That she believed gave her strength to continue.

questions.def: 'What' is used to introduce the nominal relative clause.
questions.question: ___ the witness ___ is inadmissible.

questions.def: 'What' introduces the nominal clause and acts as subject.
questions.question: ___ is unknown is the motivation behind the attack.

questions.def: 'What' is used to introduce the nominal relative clause.
questions.question: The article analyzes ___ caused the economic downturn.
